It reads claim DB update files, processes patient and medical institution information, and produces printed output for labor accident and aftercare delegation fee claim forms.

verdict.notes: The file is genuine COBOL source from the open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system, a well-known Japanese healthcare billing platform. Japanese comments are encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS but decoded as latin-1, producing mojibake. The program is clearly production-grade with copyright headers, revision history, structured error handling, and modular sub-program calls. Dialect is likely Fujitsu NetCOBOL or a compatible compiler used on Linux/Unix for ORCA, targeting COBOL-85 with some COBOL-2002 constructs possible.
